paragraphs: General Electric Company (d.b.a GE Aerospace) is an American aircraft engine supplier that is headquartered in Evendale, Ohio, outside Cincinnati. It is the legal successor to the original General Electric Company founded in 1892, which split into three separate companies between November 2021 and April 2024, adopting the trade name GE Aerospace after divesting its healthcare (GE HealthCare) and energy (GE Vernova) divisions.

GE Aerospace both manufactures engines under its name and partners with other manufacturers to produce engines. CFM International, the world's leading supplier of aircraft engines and GE's most successful partnership, is a 50/50 joint venture with the French company Safran Aircraft Engines. As of 2020, CFM International holds 39% of the world's commercial aircraft engine market share (while GE Aerospace itself holds a further 14%). GE Aerospace's main competitors in the engine market are Pratt & Whitney and Rolls-Royce.

The division operated under the name of General Electric Aircraft Engines (GEAE) until September 2005, and as GE Aviation until July 2022. In July 2022, GE Aviation changed its name to GE Aerospace in a move executives say reflects the engine maker's intention to broaden its focus beyond aircraft engines. In April 2024, GE Aerospace became the only business line of the former General Electric conglomerate, after it had completed the divestiture of GE HealthCare and GE Vernova (its energy businesses division).

people.name: H. Lawrence Culp, Jr.
people.title: Chairman of the Board & Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Has served as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer since October 2018.
people.quote: H. Lawrence Culp, Jr. , Chairman and Chief Executive Officer

people.name: Rahul Ghai
people.title: Senior Vice President & Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Joined the Company in August 2022 and assumed his current executive officer position in September 2023. Previously served as Chief Financial Officer of Otis Worldwide Corporation and Harris Corporation.
people.quote: Prior to joining the Company in August 2022, Mr. Ghai had been Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Otis Worldwide Corporation

people.name: Mohamed Ali
people.title: Senior Vice President & Chief Executive Officer, Commercial Engines & Services
people.bio: Became CEO, Commercial Engines & Services effective February 1, 2026, with the business expanding to include the Technology & Operations organization he previously led. Originally joined the Company in 1997.
people.quote: Mr. Ali became CEO, Commercial Engines & Services (CES) effective February 1, 2026

people.name: Christian Meisner
people.title: Senior Vice President & Chief Human Resources Officer
people.bio: Joined the Company in October 2023 and assumed his current executive officer position in April 2024. Previously served as Chief Human Resources Officer at Kaiser Permanente and held leadership roles at United Technologies and Otis Elevator Company.
people.quote: Prior to joining the Company in October 2023, Mr. Meisner had been Chief Human Resources Officer at Kaiser Permanente

people.name: John R. Phillips III
people.title: Senior Vice President, General Counsel & Secretary
people.bio: Joined the Company in October 2023 and assumed his current executive officer position in April 2024. Previously served as Deputy Counsel to the President of the United States and Legal Adviser to the National Security Council, following 13 years in legal leadership roles at Boeing.
people.quote: Prior to joining the Company in October 2023, Mr. Phillips had been Deputy Counsel to the President of the United States

people.name: Russell Stokes
people.title: Senior Vice President, Former Chief Executive Officer, Commercial Engines & Services
people.bio: Is serving in an advisory role to assist with the Commercial Engines & Services leadership transition and plans to retire effective July 31, 2026. The executive officer table lists September 2018 as the date he assumed an executive officer position.
people.quote: Mr. Stokes is serving in an advisory role to assist with the transition and plans to retire effective July 31, 2026.

people.name: Amy Gowder
people.title: Senior Vice President & CEO, Defense & Systems
people.bio: Joined the Company in April 2022 and assumed her current executive officer position in April 2024. Previously served as Chief Operating Officer at Aerojet Rocketdyne after 14 years at Lockheed Martin.
people.quote: Prior to joining the Company in April 2022, Ms. Gowder was Chief Operating Officer at Aerojet Rocketdyne

people.name: Ricardo Procacci
people.title: Senior Vice President & CEO, Propulsion & Additive Technologies
people.bio: Became CEO, Propulsion & Additive Technologies in 2022 and assumed an executive officer position in April 2024. Previously served as Chief Executive Officer of Avio Aero, a General Electric Company affiliate, since 2014.
people.quote: Prior to becoming CEO, Propulsion & Additive Technologies in 2022, Mr. Procacci served as Chief Executive Officer of Avio Aero

people.name: Robert Giglietti
people.title: Vice President, Chief Accounting Officer, Controller and Treasurer
people.bio: Originally joined the Company in 2002 and assumed his current role in 2024. Previously held senior finance and accounting roles, including Treasurer for GE Aerospace, Chief Financial Officer - GE Capital and Corporate, and Operational Leader for the GE separations.
people.quote: Prior to becoming Vice President, Chief Accounting Officer, Controller and Treasurer in 2024, Mr. Giglietti served in a number of senior finance and accounting leadership roles

people.bio: Chairman of GE Aerospace since April 2024 and CEO since June 2022; formerly Chairman and CEO of GE from 2018 to 2024. Previously served as CEO and President of Danaher from 2001 to 2014.
